name: LiveryOS — Finance
description: Revenue, payments, affiliate settlements. Currency rows are side-by-side, never summed across currencies.

cards.title: Revenue per day per currency
cards.query: SELECT day, currency, revenue_minor / 100.0 AS revenue, paid_invoices FROM v_bi_revenue_per_day WHERE tenant = {{tenant}} ORDER BY day

cards.title: Payment funnel by gateway
cards.query: SELECT gateway, currency, authorized, captured, refunded, released_auths, captured_minor_total / 100.0 AS captured_total FROM v_bi_payment_funnel WHERE tenant = {{tenant}}

cards.title: Affiliate settlements per partner (weekly)
cards.query: SELECT week, partner_ref, currency, partner_minor / 100.0 AS partner_share, operator_minor / 100.0 AS operator_share FROM v_bi_affiliate_settlements WHERE tenant = {{tenant}} ORDER BY week

cards.title: GA migration quarantine rate
cards.query: SELECT batch_id, imported, quarantined, quarantine_pct FROM v_bi_ga_import_health WHERE tenant = {{tenant}} ORDER BY batch_id
